descFull: Free Active Directory pentesting tool for Linux. Automates AD and LDAP enumeration, Kerberoasting, ASREPRoast, password spraying, ADCS/ESC1, DCSync, RBCD, gMSA, shadow credentials, NTLM relay and credential dumping across 104 techniques, mapping BloodHound-compatible attack paths to Domain Admin. NIS2 / ISO 27001 reports. No Windows needed.
